K-Dog:
K-Dog cannot sit still.
K-Dog is sad he can’t lick his own balls. (Guy is his idol).
K-Dog doesn’t mind sleeping outside, so long as there’s plenty of beer nearby.
K-Dog is his name, K-Dog is his nature.
Amen.
Kaden: As a rather idealistic young lad, he always wanted to work with animals. Right now though, he's volunteering at the zoo shovelling a ton of elephant shit. So, keep going brother, you'll get there in the end. Have you thought about university and coming at it from the other end? There's a lot to be said for an education...
Kaelen: Come on, stop lounging around and walking with your shoulders slumped forward! Stand up man! Piss off that video game crap or soon your body will have forgotten what it is to move, and to feel wonderful, physical pain.
Kahn: Had Kahn been born an American indian and was alive when the white-man was taking over his land and killing his people, he would have had more white-fella scalps hanging from his waist than anyone. And he's got a wicked sense of humour.
Kai: Not dissimilar in nature to Rick, Kai has a ton of energy and a mind that won’t easily switch off. He quite literally hasn’t got time for enemies as he’s continually wondering how he can get to that great spot, just over the horizon...
Kaiden: Kaiden sits there like a rat trap, ready and willing but uncertain of when a rat, or a romantic interest, or a job, or the right travel destination, or the right car might arrive so he can move quickly and snatch it. Nice looking trap though, and he's ready all right. I wouldn't want to get him on a wrong day...
Kailan: A nice fellow leading a normal, social and productive life. He has friends who like and admire him, although he doesn't often tell them where he's going. In that regard it takes a while for people to catch up with what he's been up to and what his ambitions are. Indeed, Kailan, what are they? You may as well tell us while we've got you here...
Kainoa: Once he gets his orientation right, and we’re not talking about his sexuality, Kainoa will be fine. A regularly-worn neck tie will kill him. This man, whilst not a genius, is a traveller. Even a skateboard will do him good, no matter how old he is.
Kairo: Did his parents get lost, somewhere? Anyway, Kairo is a nice, placid kind of fellow who solves most problems placed in front of him. Sure, he’s a little timid in bed but, hey, no one is perfect!
Kal: An American-Canadian who was born as Karl. He was never that intricate a personality, anyway, but as soon as he rode his first horse it was obvious that the name Carl (or Karl) couldn’t be said smoothly while sitting in the saddle at a gentle canter. And that was that; Kal became Kal and to this day he’s a good and gentle person. Most animal lovers are.
Kalani: Kalani wants to get moving, even if it’s via a video game he’s obsessed by. No, we can’t say he adores responsibility but it’s not his fault. He’s more of a loner than someone who gravitates people to them naturally, although he doesn’t mind a risky dare. Women are attracted to him not for what he says or does, but more via his general vibe. Does that make sense?
Kale: While not a true loner, Kale can and does work very well on his own. Usually, it's only because the tasks he gets involved with take some explaining - Kale is no fool - such that by the time he's finished describing what needs to be done and what you need to look out for, he could have done it himself. Kale.
Kamali: The classy, educated and well-dressed feral.
Kamran: Honourable. He’ll blow the whistle if he has to and he’ll wear the consequences, because he knows that someone has to.
Kane: The term given to the facial expression of a man who has just been kicked in the nuts.
Kapani: Like the man himself, his name is calm and energetic with a perfect composition. And that’s Kapani’s secret – it’s all about balance.
Karim: A lanky, goofy sort of lad who shirks 97% of his responsibilities. He’s a poor scholar and an outrageous flirt - it’s probably the only aspect of his life in which he isn’t lazy.
Karl: In a past life Karl was a Nazi. But that was in a past life. What he hasn't shed (or learnt) yet is that one doesn't have to be organised to the minute all the time. Indeed, sometimes Karl, just close  your eyes and let your heart take you where the universe deems fit.
Karl-Angus: Karl-Angus is often a little heavy-handed in dealings. Does he think things through fully? Well, we hope so. He's not a violent or aggressive man, don't get that impression, but he's the kind of fellow who would pull out a one wood on the putting green. Economy of movement and words is also important here. If you're going out with one, don't be put-out if he doesn't talk for a day or three, sometimes. He's only worried about the diff on the car, or something physical like that. It's got nothing to do with you.
Karmichael: Karmichael concentrates very well. You should see him in the kitchen. He's quite the cook, truth be known, but, geez, by looking at him you wouldn't necessarily think that he's enjoying himself, which I can assure you he is. Does he have a penchant to follow the recipe to the exact last letter? Maybe that's his problem?
Kase: Staunch. Committed. Kase can take a lot of abuse before he cracks, and if you mess with his system, his set-up or try to mess with his head in some way as a prank then you can expect to cop the consequences.
Kasey: "Superannuation??...Do you mean, I have to put money away for when I'm 80! Are you serious? That's not fair!"
Kayd: Kayd feels fine so long as his clothes aren't too clean. Or too ironed for that matter. And he detests being fussed over.
Kayden: A capable lad who generally doesn’t wait for life to come to him. Like Jim, however, complex issues may occasionally prove to be extremely problematic.
Kazaria:
Was Kazaria born way out, no where city lights? Okay, good. In this instance Kazaria is one of the few men who quite literally cannot deal with the city. Give him dust, give him flood, give him animals and land to work with, just don't give him hustle and bustle. The only buildings Kazaria is happy to be near that are greater than two stories high are the following: there's a pub 400 miles that way, and there are two wheat silos 350 miles that way. 

Beyond that, give him raw blue sky and stars. 

Now, was he born in the city? Alright, just get him out of there. Surrounded by the human maelstrom his inner sensitivities will override his better judgement and he'll wind up with a substance abuse problem. (Not that this is the end of the world, but he's just better off away from all that human traffic.)
KC: ...if only K.C was able to write a story of his life and his pleasures. He has enjoyed the wild and wicked delights of the orient and beyond, and everyday he wakes up, looks about, and roars with the notion that his master may very well make him famous, today. K.C is the name of Kevin’s Cock and I will tell you, ladies and gentlemen, gentlemen especially, that K.C wants to be your friend.
Keanu: Keanu functions like a river, quietly going about his business and nourishing all those who take the time.
Keaton: Shrinks tell us that all of us suffer from autism in some form or other. Keaton's is exhibited in a rather strange way. He is one of the few people in the Kingdom who will play practical jokes on himself. Because he has a shocking memory and a need for constant surprises he'll often set up some kind of reasonably harmless booby trap that he knows he'll forget about. Then, three months later, when he's opening some unused cupboard or reaching under some car seat, BANG, he'll cop it. Alternately, someone else will cop the ruse and he'll laugh just as much.
Keegan: Is he from a freezing clime? Maybe, but he tends to perform better in the cold. Indeed, like Heather he may even subconsciously sabotage perfectly healthy or normal situations in order to make something worth overcoming. Know what I mean?
Keenan: Is he a keen man? Probably. He’s also ostensibly conservative and pragmatic.
Kehl:
Like the teak deck of a yacht which is in the water and prepared to put to sea, Kehl is ready. He’s been sanded and varnished several times and he’s therefore not prone to sitting around anymore. He’s streamlined and excited about what life will throw at him, big seas or small. You’ll never see Kehl in some shed out the back for years, awaiting glory. Kehl has his game face on, in conjunction with a sense of humour – don’t worry about that – and he wants to live. Starting now.

So, you up for it?...
Keifer: A terse-looking man and Chief Negotiator.
Keith: Keith's greatest pleasure in life is the 20 yard walk to the 'out house' that's made of old corrugated iron, for his morning constitutional. And when he gets there he relaxes in his own company while the kids, grandkids, great grandkids and others babble and yell and carry-on inside the house, which right now is a million miles away. Praise the Lord.
Kellan: Very similar to guys like Parish, Kenny and even a proactive Graeme, Kellan seems to get a lot done without anyone ever actually seeing him do anything. It's quite a skill, I suppose. He has plenty of friends and he is a socially active individual, but as I say, no one ever witnesses the deeds which provide the rest of us with an assurance he is living his life actively, which he obviously is.
Kellen: Kellen is the opposite of a bower bird. Bower birds, you see, collect all manner of pointless bits of plastic and coloured chunks of metal and feathers and bones and stones and god-knows-what else for the sole purpose of attracting a mate. The notion of a human Kellen cluttering his life/bedroom/car/anything is enough to give him palpitations. However, if he’s a suit-wearing fellow, and 90% of Kellens are, then he is likely to arrange his ties in a spectacularly ordered fashion based on their colour gradation…..so, mmmm, maybe he is a bit of a secretive little bower bird after all?
Kellum: No, it’s not Callum, it’s Kellum, and do you reckon he doesn’t get that thrown at him every other day? The result is a forgiving fellow - usually - who doesn’t take the bull by the horns as often as he should. In his younger years he’s a little lost but he’ll grow out of it.
Kelly:
Kelly is a quick-witted and nimble, and his balance has to be seen to be believed. 
(Note: if he's old and a drinker, then, like all Kellys, he'll do it to the best of his ability, in which case he might sport a fantastically massive gut that he acquired via years of fully-fledged over indulgence. It’ll probably kill him in the end and that’s okay by him – he’ll tell you that something has to.)
Kelsey: Congenial and good-natured, Kelsey doesn't rush into things. He tends to let life come at him and in doing so he seems to have more time than most. Not prone to digging trenches, either for the plumbing or the military, Kelsey will delegate and gently coerce where he sees fit. He's educated, or at least he looks like he is, and he isn't a brawler.
Kelso: As an independent operator, Kelso can truck it, he can track it and he can steal it without anyone knowing he was even there. But not if it means hurting or harming an innocent person because the man has morals.
Keltem: At parties he kind of stands back from the crowd, sort of melding with the shadows. If you can be bothered talking to him it's worth it, though.
Kelvin: Kelvin wears a mullet hairdo, a huge moustache and at a large and hairy 52 years of age believes he’s a sex God. And perhaps he is...
Kelvyn: He waited a long time for the new gay marriage laws to come into act and, this week, after years together, he's going to propose to his beloved.
Kenai: Can I? You sure can. But you better hurry 'cause he knows what he's doing and he won't take long. He'll see you at the next pit-stop, okay? Make sure you bring water, it's hot out here and he runs fast and straight. Kenai.
Kendall: Kendall sneaks up on success and glory like a hunter quietly stalking his quarry, although he's never that obsessed that he won't duck down the street for a cup of coffee with his friends if asked.
Kenneth: Kenneth is the name of the face that every man pulls when he shaves the most difficult part of skin on his face – often it’s that bit just underneath the nostrils – and the more ridiculous the Kenneth, the easier it is to get to. There’s a trade off in all that we do, after all.
Kenny: Kenny is more lively than his older cousin (Ken) but...what does he do with his time? He always seems to be cruising around but, does he have a job? Where does he go on the weekend? Has he got a girlfriend? Does he have any responsibilities, at all??....Anyone?
Kent: As a distant relative of Evan, Kent can keep you awake for hours. Kent….Kent…..Kent, drips the leaking tap. If you don't get up and do something about it you'll get no sleep at all. Nice guy though, and tremendously experimental in bed and with (the vary rare) wedding proposals.
Kentan: Now here is a man who dots his I's and crosses his T's. His name looks and sounds like a newly filleted fish frame that's just been tossed to the waiting pelicans. (And you can't fish miles from shore on a 20 knot-day without knowing what the hell you're doing, and without having all your safety gear.) But, he knows how to let his hair down as well so don't presume he can’t or doesn't. As an adult, Kentan has a plethora of male friends and his fair share of doting ladies in his wake. Most important, just remember that mediocrity, ladies and gentlemen, is none of his business.
Kenton: If Kenton ever farted publicly there's a good chance he'd be so embarrassed that he'd emigrate.
Kenzo: A Japanese tiger. A sexual Buddha. And get this, he’s a postman.
Keppler: Despite a flailing mass of arms, legs and elbows, Keppler is an honest performer who does a good job.
Kern: A humorous and generous philosopher, no matter what he's doing.  He's definitely never stern, put it that way.
Kerry: Far more capable than his female namesake, Kerry is self assured, energetic and well suited to positions of power and influence, although he never sees it like that – he’s just having a good time and not wasting any while he’s at it.
Kes: Kinda’ lazy yet kinda’ busy. Maybe he’s just tired? Kes is a good fellow who does the right thing 96% of the time.
Ketch: Clean and purposeful, Ketch is excellent in his own company but that’s not to say he’s a loner. His peaceful attitude makes him very tough to be angry around and the ladies appear to be attracted to him without him really needing to say or do anything.
Kev: The Natural. This man’s man can cope with the seventy eight staff that work for him like he can cope with going to bed when he’s knackered, no worries.
Kevin: An enthusiastic dunce and the name of any tourist who pulls his shorts up around his armpits and tucks his socks into his sandals.
Kewan: Has Kewan ever rushed anything in his life? We don't think so. Thing is though, he's always on time, he never dresses like an unmade bed and his personal grooming regime is above average - as is his intelligence, as a matter of fact. Mmm, yes, Kewan is quite an interesting dude. He's not a plasterer.
Khell-ore: (Pron. Shar-loo-vaar) You can’t say his name without a mouthful of marbles but he is a relaxed and friendly customer, as are most expat Norwegians. And the complexity of his name in this English-speaking land gives him great scope to become something out of the ordinary.
Khobi: Khobi can't seem to eat without getting his food scattered everywhere, even at 18 years of age. His drives his poor mother insane.
Kiah: Kiah will never suffer from arthritis and is currently enrolled in the performing arts.
Kiel: Indeed he is a keel of sorts. A pillar for his family and his local community, Kiel rarely puts himself first. His only failing if he has one is that he can be very stubborn, which, when you think about, is most of the reason he makes a good pillar in the first place.
Kier: Indeed, Kier is like a pier. A very long pier that juts out into the bay. Yes, it's true, not many boats pull up to him anymore - there's a larger, newer jetty just up the coast made of steel and concrete. But I hear a rumour that a sailing ship is coming to town and they don't want to moor next to something new. They want to be tied-up to a structure that loves tradition and that can't be walked on with bare feet. Kier is made of old splintering wood, remember.
Kieran: Kieran is a genial fellow who moves easily through the world and without much fanfare, and he possesses an unusual amount of pluck because he understands the benefits of dedicated application. He might even be pretty good with a guitar.
Kieren:
His name falls out of your mouth without any effort whatsoever, and the two 'e's help, but here's a question:

Kieren, my lad, are you a little lazy? Do you just cruise along without putting in much effort? Would you say the world in existence for you and you alone? It's not often that we suggest this, up here in the commentary box, but a little later on, not today, you might be well-served by entering into fatherhood. 

I know....crazy eh? The fact is that you've tons of energy, you're not a twit and you need something to keep you guessing. Let us know how you go....Management.
Kieron: His back is too straight when he runs. Sure, it's great that he's trying to produce a perfect technique but we're all different, and we all move differently. When is he going to close his eyes and give himself to the rhythm of what's going through him? Kieron, some advice from up here in the box: Throw out all your text books and listen to your inner-self for a while. You can always come back to the books/accounts ledger/meetings list/technical issues later.
Killian: No, Killian isn't cautious, he just takes his time. In fact he's extremely laid back in general and his sense of humour is a dominant force in his life. He seems to sport very few issues and he is a great comfort to those who do. Possibly not CEO material, but you never can tell, and he's not going to labour all day in a sweltering concrete pit, either.
Kim: Deceptively lively. Kim doesn’t often show his emotions and he scowls a lot of the time in an attempt to convince the world that he is, in fact, a man and he’s a staunch realist as a result.
Kimbo: The cat in a human body. Know them and you’ll know Kimbo.  (Note: He’s the sort of fellow that buys $20,000 worth of shares in a few companies listed on the stock exchange, and then promptly forgets what price he bought them at.)
Kingsley: Kinglsey rides a gallant steed on his expansive estate, thinking that the American military satellites are watching his every move. Good luck Kingsley. (And in case you're interested just remember that young Kinglsey enjoys getting nude at the drop of a hat.)
Kingston:
The fox-hunt bugle sounds loudly. Can you hear it?
“...Brrr Brrr Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!! Brrr Brrr Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!”
Woah, here he comes! Yep, it's Kingston! Stark bollock naked, apart from that bloody hat, of course, tearing off down the street, scaring and scarring grannies for life.
“....Brrr, Brrr, Brrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrrr!”
And there he goes, off into the distance, a huge smile on his face and with the cops in hot pursuit. God love him.
Kinton: Kinton would make a splendid botanist or entomologist, only because he’s a stickler for categorising things about which he has a genuine passion for. He has sex with the lights off.
Kip:
“The past is the past, and if you deal with each moment well then why worry about anything?” 
Indeed. 
Kip.
Kippo: Kippo manages to bring out the animal in all the 'good' girls. We don't quite understand it either.
Kipros: “Yeah, yeah, we’ve heard  how tough it was for your parents about a million times, Kipros. We know they’re proud of you, and we know you’ve turned out well, okay? So shut up and let us get on with it. You’re not only the wonderful person in this room…..And don’t look so hurt.”
Kirby: Kirby is as useful, artistic and inspiring as a single cucumber sitting on a clean white plate. He is therefore quite unique.
Kirk: Kirk is openly defiant and heroic in situations where a public wrong has occurred.
Kit:
Kit would make a splendid medical doctor. Why? Because he’s smart, he’s optimistic, he loves people, he’s humorous in a very subtle way and he is experimental. 
And yes, he loves donning a surgeon’s mask, purely for the theatre of it, pardon the pun.
Klaw: Klaw continually itches for a good time.
Klayton: A male version of the female Eboni.
Klyde: Just like Cyril, actually, Klyde has never heard of the internet, because he spends every waking moment, come rain, hail or shine, up to his navel in water. Is he the world's most devout trout fisherman? …….Maybe.
Knobby: Where is Knobby? Well, he's here, he's there, at least, he was a minute ago. Where is that cheeky little bastard? Christ, he just handed me a drink and now he's gone again! He's making the coach turn grey.
Knobsy: Knobsy lives for drinks with the boys. And he's a popular man.
Knox: Another lad who partied until the third dawn, at which point the cops showed up bearing guns, handcuffs and paddy wagons. Last we heard he was in law school, which is kind of ironic.
Koa:
How does he do it, this fellow? He wanders around, kind of looking up at the stars, jogging and sort of bumbling his way through life. Many people, even many of his family members who think they know him, consider Koa to be a little lazy, or a tiny bit shy. Maybe abit of both, and sometimes either of those qualities can lead to the other, but what they don't know is that Koa has two rather wonderful aces up his sleeve.

One, he has a really good heart and, two, he his lucky.

And again, one inexorably leads to the other.
Amen to that.
Kobe: Should have been one of the big cats because you can barely hear his feet touch the ground. Oh, hang on. Is he asleep?
Koben:
As a mild-mannered modern man, Koben is probably better off staying away from the armed forces although he makes a better soldier than a General. As a normal, slightly-shy fellow, he's more secretive than his peers and we look forward to hearing about his greater ambitions.

Koben? Any thoughts?...
Kobi: Kobi marches where he's told to march, and that's fine. What he should do, before the battalion is called out, especially, is pack his gear one night and go AWOL. Get out into the world captain and have a look around, then you can think about who you want to follow and why.
Kobus: Kobus is happiest when he’s able to break down a situation into calculable portions where there are definitive, observable actions and reactions. He’s another fellow who’d make a good air traffic controller, but he may be too analytical for a soppy love affair. Then again, maybe that’s exactly what he needs?…
Kochie: A cross between Walshy and Jacko, Kochie is a flamboyant shit-stirrer who loves donning his wife's knickers when he's drunk, at which point he uses a shoe as a pretend microphone while he sings.
Kody: Kody approaches life in a piecemeal fashion almost accidentally. As we keep saying up here in the commentary box, we all have a niche to fill and not everyone can just blaze in and leap at the first chance, grasp it between their teeth and rejoice in their victory…but then again, Kody, why not?
Kohl: Kohl is ready. What job would you like him to do? He'll do it without fear nor favour and you can expect the job to be done on time and with discretion.
Konrad: A brand of fake Louis Vuitton travel bags.
Korin: One of the Gifted Ones. True artistry, in any way, shape or form drips from his fingertips.
Kosta:
“Life is all here in this moment,” is what he’ll tell you. “Fuck the past. Fuck the future. Do you understand me?” 
He’s infuriating after a while, true enough, but what do you do?
Kovak: Hungarian. Shy, wild and wise, Kovak is an incredible guitarist. When he plays, it sings of love and therefore forgiveness.
Kris: Kris spends a lot of time down there in the basement, on his own. I shudder to think what the hell he's doing down there - inventing something, I hope, and not masturbating in the nude for days. You just never know. He does do obsession very well, however.
Krishna: Big shoes to fill there, hoss. No one is God or the Buddha, but you ARE gentle and serene, so who knows? Are you a vegan, or is that just too cliched? You definitely don't work as a trader at the stock exchange, put it that way. Maybe you're an expert in the Kama Sutra? Our best hope?....You are the friendly fellow at the local organic fruit 'n veg shop who knows, and is delighted to see, everyone.
Kristan: Kristan is a piston. He pumps it, he works it, and he rarely sits idle, mostly due to the fact that he's on the run from a very feminine name. But, a fine fellow he is, and he works hard and conscientiously.
Kristian: Kristian is heterosexual, probably, and yet he owns and runs a shop that sells bras and lingerie for women. Shaves his arm hair. Very odd.
Kristof: Have a look at him will you? He's in more strife (debt) than the early settlers but there he is, dressed in a nice (borrowed) suit, a glass of (stolen) champagne in hand, talking to that pretty lady over there in the corner. Right about now he’s telling her about his legend status. Unbelievable…
Krusey: Has dread-locks that are four feet long and seven years old. He sells African drums at a fair market.
Krystian: Come on, boy! It's time to FACE THY DEMONS!!
Kuba: A long time back, Kuba made a very rare decision: rather than procure a tattoo or 30, which he may have done anyway, he decided to get an American basketball singlet actually sewn onto him, because that's all he seems to wear, anywhere. (Tell me he's altered that, someone, please....)
KungFu: A young man with an Asian heritage. Young or old, Kung Fu is a funny, intelligent guy and far more proactive than those who gave him his nickname.
Kurtis: Kurtis is no fool and also goes by the alias of, The Skunk!
Kurty:
Sitting at an outdoor table with nothing on but a pair of faded work pants and a smoking fag in his hand, Kurty will only listen to a discussion about what to do if you see a snake within 10 kilometres of the homestead for so long, before he tilts his head back, blows smoke into the air and barks, “Don’t be stupid. Just get the fucken shotgun and shoot it.”
Discussion over.
Kuyan: Kuyan is lost in dreamland. When he returns can you ask him to go and report to the career counsellor please? We've got some ideas he might like...
Ky: Ky is a young and energetic man at heart who operates inside the bare balls of a situation, which enables him to concentrate on the target. Something like peer group pressure barely registers with him at all.
Kya: Perhaps Kya needs to start a rebellion? Obeying orders is fine for a while, but not forever. Sooner or later you must find your own feet underneath your own heart. Sir Kya. Ditch the group. Get out on your own. You've got what it takes and you've got the nous. Don't let other opinions blind you. Most of them are on some bullshit, power-fix anyway.
Kye: His deeds of bravery are largely misread. Yes, he's lazy and keeps a messy space, but he'd take a bullet for the team if need be. He's quite single-minded, like that.
Kylar: His mood is generally smooth and kind of hidden, and you'd never know if he was lustful or angry, or anything really. Kylar is a thinker and it'll take a while to get in passed the defence maze...
Kyle:
Kyle' is what you shout out after you cut yourself in the kitchen with a serrated knife. Good luck! But being maximally tenacious and successful points to a few important facts: 
1. He's extremely bright.
2. Poor impressions of his behaviour or demeanor are water off a duck's back. 
3. If society falls apart via some kind of catastrophe then be rest assured Kyle will not capitulate with the first wave.  
Kyle.
Kym: No, he's not really a stand-up comedian, although he does like to laugh, even though it presents as more of a thoughtful chuckle. Outlandish and roguish behaviour are rarely attributed to him, but he is a deep thinking man who has the capacity to solve intricate problems. He makes a patient biologist and an excellent card player, mostly because he has one of the best poker faces in the Kingdom. That and the fact he can sit in one position for hours with little or no discomfort.
Kymani: Kymani is a man of the earth or the water. Yep, he looks fine and healthy because he is. He hasn’t much of a clue about how to hook up a new printer, build a LinkedIn profile or foster a compelling work ethic within an organisation. He grows herbs, he might even smoke some of them, he doesn't appreciate hyperactivity and he loves it when thunder busts in on a hot afternoon.
Kynah: Kynah doesn't give in to propoganda. You can tell him whatever you like but unless he is certain of your standing, you can expect him to go and check out the facts for himself.
Kynan: Good at maths (and academia in general) Kynan's friends have no idea how much brighter than them he really is. Early on he's a shy man, this Ky-nan, but he'll find his feet and get comfy in his skin, don't you worry. A wee snippet of advice chief: Don't head to trade school just because you're tired of regimented classes. Give yourself some time to evolve, and to make a base for a greater range of outcomes later. You can work with your hands at home any time, if you're that keen. Just don't give up on your creative brain because you're allowed to be amazing. Indeed, the universe encourages it. Good luck.
Kyran: Here’s a nice little anecdote about how Kyran’s brain works. Say he was driving on the highway at 100km/hr and a front wheel suddenly detached. In that crucial nano-second prior to potential catastrophe, rather than panic, he would grasp the steering wheel hard and actually smile at what absurd, comical situation was about to play out. Kyran is very inquisitive, don’t forget, and what better moment to be utterly fascinated by than your possible imminent death?
Kyron: I wonder if Kyran and Kyron are related? Anyway, with a name that sounds like some kind of traffic violation, it makes sense then that Kyron loses his driver's licence every three years. He hasn’t killed anyone yet so that’s a bonus and so long as he doesn't kill himself in the meantime we’ll be happy. So, Kyron, do up your seat belt and get your arse to a good driving school. Maybe you should race?
Kyuss:
Option A: Named after a heavy metal band, and what does that mean? Yep - he's destined for a life in the clergy. 

Option B: The name of an Alsatian who is very well trained by quite an anal owner.
